description: This PHP source file defines the MyTimesheetController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It handles pre-rendering logic for the user's timesheet view, including ensuring a default timesheet exists and setting up Vue.js components with date properties.

classes.name: MyTimesheetController
classes.description: A controller class for managing the user's timesheet view, ensuring the presence of a default timesheet and setting up the Vue component with relevant properties.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components for rendering the timesheet view, including optionally adding a startDate property based on request parameters.

methods.name: createDefaultTimesheetIfNotExist
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for the current date and employee; if not, creates a new default timesheet.
